notes.title: Version 1.04.00 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119750/28420db77b7944be1ca69c0dd33db666e650841d.png[/img]

The 1.04.00 update brings the following changes to the game:

[list]
[*] DLC Vol. 3: Team Primrose is now available in-game for players who have purchased it. Please view details here: 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2313020/view/512943879502168906][b]DLC Vol. 3: Team Primrose Out Now[/b][/url]
[*] Added new Clubroom furniture (40 character plushies). The new items can be purchased with Tracen Points from the "Furniture" tab in the shop.
[*] Support for simplified Chinese, traditional Chinese, and Korean has been added to Golshi's Grand Adventure 2.
[*] Adjusted minigame help messages.
[*] Fixed an issue in which some players would be automatically removed from a lobby even when not experiencing connectivity problems.
[*] Other various bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.02.01 Update for Steam®
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119750/84d088ad158841188ca216c24e185b0e83acf35d.png[/img]

The 1.02.01 update brings the following changes to the game:

・Fixed an issue where a player wouldn't be able to end an online game after all other players had left. A message will now be displayed before the start of the next event indicating that there aren't enough players, and the lobby will be disbanded.

・A controls guide has been added to the initial tutorials displayed for each event. It can also be accessed at any time during an event from How to Play in the pause menu.

・A controls guide has been added to the pages for each of the four events as well as Golshi's Grand Adventure 2 in the Help section.

・Edited some in-game text.

notes.title: Version 1.01.03 Update for Steam®
notes.content:
The 1.01.03 update for the Steam® version of the game brings the following changes:
[list]
[*] Adjusted the message displayed for a communication error due to poor connection after matching in online play to be more specific.
[*] Fixed an issue where a communication error would sometimes occur for all players in a Quick Match, even when only some had connectivity issues.
[/list]

The above fix should alleviate problems players have been having with matchmaking, but we will continue to look into the root causes of any issues and apply fixes when we find them.

If you continue to have problems with matchmaking after the update, it would help us if you could leave a comment with as much of the following information as you can provide:
[list]
[*] What was happening in-game when the error occurred
[*] The error message displayed
[*] Your PC specs (from the Steam client, go to Help > System Information, then copy and paste the text displayed)
[/list]

We can't respond to each comment, but your reports will help us identify and solve any outstanding issues.

Thank you for playing Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Party Dash.

tags.balance_change: [*] Adjusted the message displayed for a communication error due to poor connection after matching in online play to be more specific.

tags.bug: [*] Fixed an issue where a communication error would sometimes occur for all players in a Quick Match, even when only some had connectivity issues.

notes.title: Known Bugs (Updated Sep 2, 2024 [JST])
notes.content:
The following bug has been confirmed as of Sep 2 (JST).

[list]
[*] An issue causing matchmaking errors when using "Online Play" in the Steam® version.
[/list]

We are currently investigating this issue and will provide updates as soon as possible.
We are also looking into other reports and will provide more information when available.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to players.
Thank you for playing Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Party Dash.
